additional_info.subject: Wordline Troubleshooting findings:
additional_info.body:
As per verified with PLM and QM, different solutions must be considered depending on type of Keyloading Error.
- Keyloading Error key installation XXXX error for key ID YYYY
--> Terminal needs to be replaced
- Keyloading Error EFT_E_CONNECTION_CLOSED"
--> Power cycle the terminal and the XF4, verify good connection , and repeat the CCT from beginning
- Setup Error EFT_S_INITIALIZATION_PENDING
--> Power cycle the terminal and the XF4, verify good connection , and repeat the CCT from beginning
As general suggestion, please ensure stable and hi-quality connection (either via installed SIM or WiFi, Hotspot, LAN or other) on XF4 whilst commissioning the CCT.
For more development in troubleshooting activities, please continue documenting activities and findings in the ticket as per the established process.
